title.zh: Strive将SATS优先股IPO扩大至700万股，筹资约6.3亿美元
title.en: Strive Upsizes SATS Preferred IPO to 7 Million Shares, Raising About $630 Millio

current_state.zh: Strive已将15% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred IPO扩大至700万股、每股90美元，募资约6.3亿美元；该优先股已在纳斯达克上市交易，按日支付15%年化固定股息，首笔股息计划于11月9日发放，募集资金用于增持比特币及投资创收资产。
current_state.en: Strive upsized its 15% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred IPO to 7 million shares at $90 each, raising about $630 million; the preferred stock now trades on Nasdaq, pays a 15% annual fixed dividend daily with the first payment scheduled for November 9, and proceeds are earmarked for adding bitcoin and investing in income-generating assets.
